# Win32FindDataA

Win32's `WIN32_FIND_DATAA`: one directory entry, as [`FindFirstFileA`](/docs/api/windows/file-system#find-first-file-a) and [`FindNextFileA`](/docs/api/windows/file-system#find-next-file-a) fill it.

```rux
pub struct Win32FindDataA {
    // private fields
}
```

The narrow form, whose names come through the process code page and so cannot express every name a file system
can hold. `Rux/FileSystem` enumerates through the wide entry points instead; this is here so a caller reaching
for the `A` family directly can name the record they take.
The fields are private: the layout is Microsoft's and reading it is the enumerating code's business.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/api/minwinbase/ns-minwinbase-win32_find_dataa](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/api/minwinbase/ns-minwinbase-win32_find_dataa)
